title: GraphIP-Bench: How Hard Is It to Steal a Graph Neural Network, and Can We Stop It?
abstract: arXiv:2605.12827v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Graph neural networks (GNNs) deployed as cloud services can be *stolen* through *model-extraction attacks*, which train a surrogate from query responses to reproduce the target's behaviour, and a growing line of ownership defenses tries to prevent or trace such theft. The title of this paper asks two questions: *how hard is it to steal a GNN?*, and *can we stop it?* Prior work cannot answer either, because experiments use inconsistent datasets, threat models, and metrics. We introduce *GraphIP-Bench*, a unified benchmark which evaluates both sides under a single black-box protocol. translated_title: GraphIP-Bench：窃取一个图神经网络有多难？我们能否阻止它？
translated_abstract: 部署为云服务的图神经网络（GNN）可能通过*模型提取攻击*被“窃取”——攻击者利用查询响应训练代理模型来复现目标模型的行为，而不断涌现的所有权防御方法则试图阻止或追踪此类窃取行为。本文的标题提出了两个问题：*窃取一个GNN有多难？*以及*我们能否阻止它？*由于以往实验使用的数据集、威胁模型和评估指标不一致，先前的工作无法回答这两个问题。我们提出了*GraphIP-Bench*，这是一个在统一黑盒协议下同时评估攻防双方的基准。它集成了十二种提取攻击、横跨水印、输出扰动和查询模式检测三大类的十二种防御方法、十个覆盖同配、异配和大规模场景的公开图数据集、三种GNN骨干网络以及三种图学习任务，并报告保真度、任务效用、所有权验证和计算成本等指标。
tldr: 提出了首个统一基准GraphIP-Bench，在单一黑盒协议下系统评估12种模型提取攻击与12种GNN知识产权防御方法（覆盖10个图数据集、3种骨干网络和3类任务），首次可靠地回答了窃取GNN的难度以及防御方法能否有效阻止窃取这两个问题。
en_tdlr: GraphIP-Bench is the first unified benchmark that evaluates 12 model-extraction attacks and 12 ownership defenses for GNNs under a single black-box protocol across diverse datasets, backbones, and tasks, providing the first reliable answers to how hard it is to steal a GNN and whether we can stop it.
